_comment: Huts listed by hand. With a "refugepro" slug: availability read from the Refuge Pro calendar the hut embeds (refuge-pro.com/embed/calendrier/<slug>). With "wpbs" pages ([{"url", "calendars" (optional ids)}]): availability read from the WP Booking System calendar of the hut's WordPress site. With "opensystem" (true): availability read from the Open System planning of the widget the hut embeds (id OPRF-<product id>, like the Vanoise park huts), with optional "guarded" seasons when the widget also sells the unguarded nights (shown 'Non gardé' outside them). Without any of these: no online booking we can read, shown as 'Sur demande'. Positions from refuges.info; contacts from each hut's own website unless noted. "guarded": the keeper's seasons [["MM-DD", "MM-DD"], ...] (a season may run over the new year); a hut without online booking is shown closed outside them.
